description.en: A cosy neighbourhood inn by the Servitenkirche. Try pork-crackling dumplings, mushroom goulash with bread dumplings or Wiener schnitzel. The MICHELIN Guide highlights its welcoming atmosphere and weekday lunch specials; diners also praise the Tafelspitz and attentive service.

description.en: An Italian restaurant in the Old Town since 1985. Its menu spans Rigatoni alla Norma with aubergine and pecorino, wood-fired Quattro Stagioni pizza, grilled prawns and tiramisu. A versatile choice for families and mixed tastes.

description.en: A stylish Italian restaurant on Tuchlauben with a minimalist interior and lively terrace. House favourites include vitello tonnato, fried calamari and saffron risotto. Ideal for an elegant lunch or dinner in central Vienna.

description.en: A lively Spanish tapas bistro in the first district, known for Iberico pluma, potato tortilla and crema catalana. Spanish wines and a buzzy bar atmosphere make it ideal for sharing plates; the MICHELIN Guide advises booking.

description.en: The 'little Wrenkh' at Rauhensteingasse 12 is a weekday lunchtime vegetarian takeaway and buffet, not the main evening restaurant. Try caramelised cabbage pasta, thyme lentils with smoked tofu and changing hot dishes and soup. The full-service restaurant is separately located at Bauernmarkt 10.

description.en: An organic-certified sausage stand in Josefstadt serving Salzburg-style Bosna, regional sausages and a vegan oyster-mushroom Bosna. House-made potato chips with salsa verde add a creative twist to Vienna street food.

description.en: A gourmet sausage stand at Börseplatz, famous as much for truffle fries, beef tartare on brioche and crisp calamari as for its sausages. House-fermented accompaniments bring an inventive twist to classic street food.

description.en: A historic Vienna sausage stand dating to 1928. Its signature Big Mama is an oversized cheese-filled Käsekrainer, joined by a wide range of hot dogs. A classic stop for a substantial late-night snack.
